confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation anchors are lower confidence because July hotel and hostel rates in Maastricht vary with events and demand. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange rates page, which I did not open directly, so verify it against the RBA F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Dutch heritage and university cities such as Leiden, Utrecht and Groningen, adjusted for Maastricht's tourist-heavy historic centre and its proximity to Belgian and German price levels. Converted at an assumed euro-to-US-dollar rate of roughly 1.15.
